optimal smoothing can reduce rate variability by a factor of 3-10 (depending on the trace and buffer size) and can reduce the network resources needed to transport video by a factor of up to 2.5.

optimal smoothing of stored video is a simple, effective way to reduce the variability of the bit rate at the client and that the reduction in bit-rate variability can significantly reduce the network resources needed to transmit stored video.

the design of effective buffer management policies for stored video.
the design and analysis of network protocols that can exploit the inherent variability of video data to achieve significant reductions in the resources required for network-based video transport.
